_meta.purpose: Worklist for kubera (Phase B): every numeric claim in legal_interpretation.json that may now be contradicted by the rebuilt data.
_meta.do_not_use_as_authoritative_truth: This file flags claims, it does not rewrite them. Phase B should rewrite legal_interpretation.json based on these flags.

status_legend.holds: claim still consistent with post-audit data
status_legend.needs_revision: claim is contradicted or numerically wrong under post-audit denominator
status_legend.should_delete: claim depended on a metric that no longer exists or was always wrong
status_legend.verify: claim should be cross-checked against current rebuilt data; cannot be auto-flagged
status_legend.resolved: Phase B revision pass addressed this claim in legal_interpretation.json
status_legend.still_pending: Phase B could not address (data not available, ambiguous, or out of scope)
